method: Full English template alignment, separately checked automatic keyword sentences, literal canonical values, and recognized literal upgrade deltas. Reviewed formatter rules select IfUpgraded branches and non-combat/non-targeting library branches. Reviewed CalculatedVar/CalculatedDamageVar library previews use CalculationBase with multiplier zero outside combat. Numeric corrections and singular/plural projections must pass strict alignment again; MaxUpgradeLevel zero excludes upgrade text. Unresolved templates, missing variants, reworks and saved-instance rules received explicit native definition/helper review and factual paraphrases. This covers printed base/first-upgrade rules, not a complete combat simulator or certification of other entity families.
limits: Base and first upgrade only. Runtime effects, per-instance customization, enchantments, relic interactions and higher upgrades are not simulated. Matching the game description does not prove the game implements that description without bugs.

instance_rules.CARD.GENETIC_ALGORITHM: CurrentBlock must equal 1 + IncreasedBlock; base/upgraded permanent increment 3/4.
instance_rules.CARD.THE_SCYTHE: CurrentDamage must equal 13 + IncreasedDamage; base/upgraded permanent increment 4/5.
instance_rules.CARD.MAD_SCIENCE: Saved TinkerTimeType and TinkerTimeRider select the reviewed type and one of nine event effects; upgrading adds Innate.
